Meet The Owner

How Next Generation Insulation Started

Dean Simpson built Next Generation Insulation on two values that mean everything to him: family and honesty. He wanted a family-run business that customers could trust, where good workmanship, professionalism and doing the right thing come before profit, and where every customer's home gets the care he'd expect for his own family.

He set out to do things differently, building a reputation through hard work, being open with people and never cutting corners. As the company grows, those family values haven't changed.

Today the team is 10 strong. Everyone is directly employed, with at least two years' service, and there are no subcontractors. Between them they cover roofing, spray foam removal and loft insulation, and Dean invests in their training and development.

"I'd rather be remembered for being honest and trustworthy than simply being the cheapest company."
Dean SimpsonFounder, Next Generation Insulation

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    Roofers and Spray Foam Specialists

    Some roofers don't fully clean the rafters, and some removal firms don't understand the roof. We do spray foam removal, roof repairs, new roofs and loft insulation under one roof.

  2. 02

    No Subcontractors

    Everyone on the team is directly employed by the company, with at least two years' service.

  3. 03

    Paperwork for Your Lender

    We photograph the work throughout, take moisture readings where needed and hand over full documentation for you, your surveyor and your mortgage lender.

  4. 04

    Only the Work You Need

    Our surveys tell you what needs doing and what doesn't. One homeowner quoted £20,000 for a new roof had the foam removed by us for £8,000 instead.

  5. 05

    Insured and Guaranteed

    We hold public liability insurance and £5,000,000 employers' liability insurance, and offer insurance-backed guarantees on eligible roofing and insulation projects, subject to the terms of the guarantee.

What We Stand For

Our Core Values

In Dean's words, honesty, politeness, trustworthiness and professionalism are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Family

    A family-run business that treats every customer's home with the care we'd expect for our own family.

  • Honesty

    Explaining things clearly, giving people our time and never pushing anyone into work they don't need.

  • Politeness

    Respect for every customer and their home, with a clean and safe place of work.

  • Trust

    Doing what we promise, so customers know they made the right choice.

  • Professionalism

    Quality workmanship and attention to detail, done right the first time.
